limits: All 24 cases come from one fixture author and four selected families; within-family source skeletons are related. They do not represent 24 random independent engineering roots.
The statuses are conditional on synthetic acquisition assertions and authored warrants. They do not establish physical truth.
The packet does not include an independent equal-checker implementation or human masked reference reviewers; parity and adjudication remain separate gates.
reviewer: Independent AI agent; no human adjudication
